The HWPX document generation task succeeded by correctly mapping event data to XML structures and passing all automated verifications.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without errors. Success was driven by the accurate manipulation of HWPX internal XML components to reflect event announcement details. Future iterations should re-check the robustness of XML namespace handling and ensure that the generated zip structure remains compliant with HWPX standards across different event metadata inputs.
